regime_context: The policy setup is a sequenced, optics-aware campaign: Bessent suppresses front-end yields structurally while Warsh holds a hawkish inflation-first line to bank credibility, deferring easing as optionality. The consensus narrative treats this as coordinated easing; revealed preference says the administration wants the outcome of lower real yields without the inflation-validating optics of near-term cuts, so the trade is yield-sensitive assets with a hike-risk buffer, not a clean duration bid.
regime_context_zh: 政策框架是一场有顺序、重观感的行动：贝森特在结构上压低前端收益率，而沃什坚守鹰派、通胀优先的立场以积累信用，把宽松留作期权。市场共识把它读成协调宽松；但显示性偏好表明，政府想要低实际收益率的结果，却不想承担近期降息所对应的通胀观感，因此交易方向应是收益敏感型资产并留出加息风险缓冲，而非单纯的久期多头。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh is holding the hawkish line with >70% odds of a September hike and no forward-guidance relief, so long duration faces repricing risk even as Bessent suppresses the front end. The steepener intent punishes TLT relative to SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什坚持鹰派立场，市场对9月加息的定价超过70%，且不给前瞻指引松口，因此长久期面临重新定价风险，即便贝森特压低前端。陡峭化意图使TLT相对SPY承压。
evidence: Iran ceasefire collapse 7/8 pushed CME FedWatch to >70% Sept hike probability (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
Warsh Sintra response 7/1 held 'prices are too high'; declined to signal July
May PCE core 3.4% y/y, highest since Oct-2023
Track record: prior TLT underweight scored hit (-0.0719) on 2026-08-01
theses.dissent: If the June labor crack widens further, Warsh could pivot to a data-driven September cut, igniting a long-duration rally that would beat SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 若6月就业恶化进一步扩大，沃什可能转向数据驱动的9月降息，触发长久期反弹并跑赢SPY。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by more than 3% while the September FOMC either cuts or signals a clear cutting path before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，TLT跑赢SPY超过3%，且9月FOMC降息或明确释放降息路径

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: The nuclear-for-AI industrial policy lever is a direct administration capital-steering mechanism, and the DOE HALEU fuel-bank release plus reactor program milestones are concrete catalysts. The energy security imperative from the Iran re-escalation reinforces the onshoring bid.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能服务AI的产业政策杠杆是政府直接引导资本的机制，DOE释放HALEU燃料库及反应堆项目节点是具体催化剂。伊朗局势再升级带来的能源安全需求强化本土化配置。
evidence: Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank for private/AI projects
Open prediction: AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program shows a contracted/sited project
Rotation theme: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle with proxies OKLO, SMR, URA
Track record: OKLO is in scorable set; SMR prior overweight missed (-0.1656) so keep conviction low
theses.dissent: Execution risk on DOE release timing and private project contracting could leave OKLO range-bound while SPY benefits from a tariff truce or Iran de-escalation.
theses.dissent_zh: DOE释放时点及私人项目签约的执行风险可能令OKLO横盘，而SPY受益于关税休战或伊朗局势缓和。

falsifier.text: OKLO lags SPY by more than 10% with no DOE HALEU release announcement or contracted reactor milestone by the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，OKLO落后SPY超过10%，且没有DOE释放HALEU的公告或反应堆签约里程碑

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized upside oil shock with Brent spiking ~$80 intraday, re-priming the energy rotation that was already Q1's top ETF-inflow sector. The administration's energy security posture and defense of strategic capacity favor XLE near-term.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂已兑现油价上行冲击，布伦特盘中涨至约80美元，重新点燃能源板块轮动——该板块一季度本就是ETF资金流入首位。政府的能源安全立场及对战略产能的保护令XLE短期受益。
evidence: FACT: US strikes on Iran 7/8–11, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Theater: Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict
Rotation theme: Energy (oil & gas) proxy XLE, XOP — headline-fragile
Track record: prior XLE overweight scored hit (+0.1012) on 2026-08-09
theses.dissent: A sudden ceasefire or Hormuz de-escalation would unwind the risk premium fast, and XLE would lag a SPY relief rally.
theses.dissent_zh: 若突然停火或霍尔木兹局势缓和，风险溢价将迅速消退，XLE将落后于SPY的缓和反弹。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by more than 5% while Brent retreats below its pre-strike level on de-escalation headlines before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，XLE落后SPY超过5%，且布伦特因缓和消息回落至打击前水平以下

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: The dealer-bank trade worked on the Bessent intermediation-reform thesis, but a hawkish hike-majority Fed with no eSLR progress yet means the catalyst is not confirmed. Prior KBE overweight scored a miss (-0.0818); without concrete eSLR-reform progress, the bank bid is speculative against a SPY baseline.
theses.thesis_zh: 交易商银行逻辑曾受益于贝森特的中介改革主题，但鹰派加息占多数的联储且eSLR改革尚无进展，意味着催化剂未确认。此前KBE超配为误判（-0.0818）；没有具体的eSLR改革推进，银行板块相对SPY只是投机。
evidence: Open prediction: Concrete eSLR-reform progress (proposed or final rule) — not yet observed
Track record: prior KBE overweight scored miss (-0.0818) on 2026-07-10
Fed path: market sees >70% Sept hike, hawkish Warsh held line at Sintra
Calibration note: Goldilocks regime hit-rate 0.364 vs Reflation 1.0; current quad is Reflation but weak labor leg is fragile
theses.dissent: A formal eSLR-reform proposal or front-end yield compression from Bessent's T-bill regime could reignite the dealer-bank bid and make KBE beat SPY sharply.
theses.dissent_zh: 若出台正式的eSLR改革提案，或贝森特的短债机制压缩前端收益率，可能重新点燃交易商银行行情并使KBE大幅跑赢SPY。

falsifier.text: KBE outperforms SPY by more than 5% after concrete eSLR-reform progress or a banking-regulator rule announcement before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日前，出现具体eSLR改革进展或银行监管规则公告后，KBE跑赢SPY超过5%
